text: Yes, all days of the period were checked for thermal detections on this property. According to the current evidence (EU-FIRE-27, version 2), every sensor (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered every day from October 1, 2026, to October 8, 2026. No thermal detections were found intersecting the asset during this period. The earlier version (EU-FIRE-27, version 1) had temporal gaps, but these were resolved in the current version.
